ResourceHeader.ResourceName: GOES-16 EXIS/XRS Science Level 2 1-second X-ray Irradiance
ResourceHeader.Description: GOES-16 EXIS/XRS science-quality Level 2 one-second irradiance (flx1s) product distributed in daily NetCDF-4 files. The product provides irradiance in the XRS-A (0.05–0.4 nm) and XRS-B (0.1–0.8 nm) bands from individual low- and high-irradiance sensors, as well as primary-channel merged irradiance values for each band. The processing also includes quality/status flags, corrected quadrant currents, and spacecraft/instrument ancillary information. This science-quality Level 2 stream is generated using retrospectively reprocessed data and updated calibrations and corrections; it is distributed separately from the operational Level 2 series used for real-time space-weather operations. NOAA recommends the science-quality XRS Level 2 series for scientific analysis; consult the XRS L2 ReadMe and User Guide for details.

Parameter.Name: Time
Parameter.Description: Record start time of each 1-second XRS L2 sample, expressed as seconds since 2000-01-01 12:00:00 UTC, neglecting leap seconds.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A Primary Irradiance
Parameter.Description: One-second solar X-ray irradiance in the XRS-A band (0.05-0.4 nm), selected from the primary detector according to the xrsa_primary_chan indicator. This is the merged primary-channel irradiance.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A1 Irradiance
Parameter.Description: One-second solar X-ray irradiance from the XRS-A1 low-irradiance high-sensitivity single photodiode.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A2 Irradiance
Parameter.Description: One-second solar X-ray irradiance from the XRS-A2 high-irradiance lower-sensitivity quadrant photodiode.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A Primary Channel Selection
Parameter.Description: Primary detector choice for XRS-A: 1 indicates detector A1, 2 indicates detector A2, and 255 indicates unknown. Refer to NetCDF flag_values and flag_meanings.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B Primary Irradiance
Parameter.Description: One-second solar X-ray irradiance in the XRS-B band (0.1-0.8 nm), selected from the primary detector according to the xrsb_primary_chan indicator. This is the merged primary-channel irradiance.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B1 Irradiance
Parameter.Description: One-second solar X-ray irradiance from the XRS-B1 low-irradiance high-sensitivity single photodiode.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B2 Irradiance
Parameter.Description: One-second solar X-ray irradiance from the XRS-B2 high-irradiance lower-sensitivity quadrant photodiode.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B Primary Channel Selection
Parameter.Description: Primary detector choice for XRS-B: 1 indicates detector B1, 2 indicates detector B2, and 255 indicates unknown. Refer to NetCDF flag_values and flag_meanings.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A Flux Quality Flags
Parameter.Description: Bit-field quality flags for xrsa_flux. Interpret flags using NetCDF flag_masks, flag_values, and flag_meanings; a value of 0 indicates good data.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A1 Flux Quality Flags
Parameter.Description: Bit-field quality flags for xrsa1_flux. Interpret flags using NetCDF flag_masks, flag_values, and flag_meanings; a value of 0 indicates good data.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A2 Flux Quality Flags
Parameter.Description: Bit-field quality flags for xrsa2_flux. Interpret flags using NetCDF flag_masks, flag_values, and flag_meanings; a value of 0 indicates good data.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B Flux Quality Flags
Parameter.Description: Bit-field quality flags for xrsb_flux. Interpret flags using NetCDF flag_masks, flag_values, and flag_meanings; a value of 0 indicates good data.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B1 Flux Quality Flags
Parameter.Description: Bit-field quality flags for xrsb1_flux. Interpret flags using NetCDF flag_masks, flag_values, and flag_meanings; a value of 0 indicates good data.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B2 Flux Quality Flags
Parameter.Description: Bit-field quality flags for xrsb2_flux. Interpret flags using NetCDF flag_masks, flag_values, and flag_meanings; a value of 0 indicates good data.

Parameter.Name: XRS-A2 Corrected Quadrant Currents
Parameter.Description: Corrected electric currents of four quadrants of the XRS-A2 detector, stored as a two-dimensional NetCDF variable indexed by time and quadrant.

Parameter.Name: XRS-B2 Corrected Quadrant Currents
Parameter.Description: Corrected electric currents of four quadrants of the XRS-B2 detector, stored as a two-dimensional NetCDF variable indexed by time and quadrant.

Parameter.Name: 1-AU Distance Correction Factor
Parameter.Description: Factor used for conversion of measured solar X-ray flux to the reference distance of 1 AU. Consult the product documentation for the correction convention.

Parameter.Name: Spacecraft Roll Angle
Parameter.Description: Angular offset of the solar position pointing reference relative to the celestial north rotational pole, measured counterclockwise.

Parameter.Name: Spacecraft Yaw Flip Flag
Parameter.Description: Spacecraft orientation indicator with NetCDF flag meanings upright (0), neither (1), and inverted (2).
